metadata.description: A collection of Agent Skills for GitHub Copilot, grouped into installable plugins.

plugins.name: testing
plugins.description: Write, review, and debug automated tests in whatever framework a repository already uses. Detects the stack at runtime rather than imposing a framework. With your agreement, will install the project's own test runner when it is missing — never anything else, and never unattended.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Review code against Google's Standard of Code Review, reporting findings with Conventional Comments labels and CWE-named security categories. Also generates a repository's agent and review rules files.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Generate architecture documentation for a repository from a parsed dependency graph rather than from memory: symbols, imports, classes and base classes come from a scanner, every module is described with its real neighbours supplied, and each structural claim is checked against the graph before it ships. Produces docs/ with file:line citations.
